about: IPMA's hourly station observations in Madeira (rain in mm per hour, mean wind), kept across reads (the feed holds 24 hours), sorted by each station's largest rain over six consecutive hourly values. Facts.

hour_label.ipma_says: IPMA's API documentation gives the key only as 'data/hora da observação' and precAcumulada as 'valor acumulado da hora (mm)'; it does not say whether a label is the hour starting or the hour ending at that time, nor the time zone.

our_inference.label: analysis
our_inference.reading: hour ENDING at the label, in UTC
why: the feed's newest key is the last full hour (e.g. 18:00 present at 18:58, 19:00 absent)
DN Madeira's 133.9 mm 'in 6 h by 22:00' at Chão do Areeiro equals the sum of the values labelled 17:00 to 22:00 at station 1210973, which is the hour-ending reading
hour ending is the usual synoptic convention

earlier_warnings.question: What rain warning covered Madeira's mountain areas (MRM) and south coast (MCS) on Tuesday 10 Nov, 12:00 to 21:00 UTC?
earlier_warnings.answer: No rain warning for MRM or MCS covering Tue 12:00-21:00 was found, in either the CAP snapshot or the press. This is not proof that none was ever issued: the CAP feed drops superseded messages, and the 9 Nov 14:05:35 messages that the red rain replaced are not in it.

items.what: MeteoAlarm CAP feed snapshot read 2026-11-10T23:50Z (saved by this desk at the time, before cap.json kept Madeira). Every Madeira rain message in it, MRM and MCS:
items.finding: No MRM or MCS rain message has a window touching Tue 10 Nov 12:00-21:00. The feed still held expired messages (e.g. yellow rain 7 Nov 09:00-18:00, sent 6 Nov 07:14:43), so a non-superseded afternoon warning would probably have shown.

items.what: DN Madeira (dnoticias.pt), dated 8 Nov 2026 (time not given): 'IPMA emite novos avisos de mau tempo para terça e quarta-feira'. Yellow rain for Madeira and Porto Santo 'a partir das 21 horas de terça-feira', 'até ao meio-dia' Wednesday; yellow wind 21:00 Tue to 10:00 Wed (mountains to 95 km/h).
items.finding: As of 8 Nov, the warning began at 21:00 Tuesday; nothing for Tuesday afternoon.
items.note: read through a fetch tool summary; evidence only

items.finding: not found: it holds only current and future warnings, no past entries
not found: no public archive endpoint found; the feed is current plus retained unsuperseded messages

earlier_warnings.lead_time_note: The red rain (21:00 Tue-06:00 Wed) was sent at 06:14:54 Tue, about 15 h ahead. The rain that fell in the hours labelled 20:00 and 21:00 (93.3 mm at Areeiro, read as hour ending) fell outside any window in the messages we hold.
earlier_warnings.card_wording: outside any window in the messages we hold (not 'unwarned')

station_warning_areas.detail: IPMA's open data gives stations (stations.json: id, name, coordinates) and warning areas (distrits-islands.json: idAreaAviso per place), but no table assigning a station to a warning area. Madeira's areas (MCN north coast, MCS south coast, MRM mountain areas, MPS Porto Santo) are not given as boundaries either.

observed_gusts.ipma_station_feeds: no gusts: observations.json and obs-surface.geojson report mean wind only (intensidadeVentoKM, intensidadeVento), per IPMA's API page
observed_gusts.where_gusts_are: airport METARs (IPMA as the aeronautical met office), read through NOAA's Aviation Weather API: Lisbon LPPT (airport.json) and Madeira LPMA (e.g. 'METAR LPMA 110100Z 20032G42KT 6000 RA BKN012 FEW018CB 22/21 Q1001': 32 kt gusting 42, read 02:31 UTC)
